The boil concentrates each figure by the pre-boil ÷ post-boil volume.

The brewhouse efficiency also counts how completely the mash dissolves the extract, so it slightly understates the salts reaching the kettle: the kettle salts come out slightly generous.

A kettle sample may read lower in calcium and higher in magnesium: calcium partly reacts with the malt's phosphate, and the malt adds its own magnesium.
